title: Visual storytelling premise
slide_intent: Choose images for the life they portray because viewers infer a city’s values from visible people, places and activities.
strategic_value: The stated mix of freedom, equality, trust and urban nature can distinguish Helsinki’s account of sustainable city life.
demonstration: This webpage text introduces visual storytelling through good sustainable life, freedom of self-expression, functionality, equality, trust, nature and a quirky atmosphere across seasons.
practical_value: Evaluate whether an image supports one of these stated city qualities.

content_islands.name: Storytelling premise
content_islands.spec: Keep the two introductory paragraphs together before the medium-specific sections.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explicitly states the image of Helsinki that visual storytelling should build.
